body:
Starry SATB Choir is a diverse, welcoming, and vibrant community mixed choir based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Our singers come from different age groups, cultural backgrounds, and musical experiences. Under professional musical direction, we bring people together through singing and use music as a way to connect, celebrate, and inspire.

The name “Starry” reflects our belief that every singer is a unique star. We believe that every voice has value, and when different voices come together, they create something greater—like a sky filled with stars.

Starry SATB Choir is committed to exploring outstanding choral music from around the world, with repertoire spanning classical, contemporary, traditional, and cross-cultural works. We have a particular interest in preserving and sharing Chinese and Asian cultural music while creating opportunities for meaningful artistic exchange with musicians, choirs, and community organizations from diverse cultural backgrounds.

Since its founding, Starry has actively participated in community cultural events and musical performances throughout Winnipeg. Through concerts, cultural celebrations, and collaborations with other ensembles and artists, we strive to create opportunities for people of different ages and cultural backgrounds to experience music together and build meaningful connections.

In 2026, Starry SATB Choir received a Gold Award at the Winnipeg Music Festival Choral Competition, and continues to expand its artistic development, community engagement, and cross-cultural collaborations.

Starry welcomes anyone who loves to sing and is willing to learn, grow, and share music with others. Regardless of musical background or experience, every voice has a place in our choir.

Let every voice shine. Together, we sing like stars.
